items.title: Smart Parking Gate
items.summary: Intelligent parking gate system with computer vision for vehicle detection and automated access control.
items.details: Smart parking access control system that detects vehicles using YOLOv8, controls a gate via servo motor, streams real-time video to a web interface, and uses MQTT for communication. Integrates ultrasonic sensors for distance measurement.

items.title: Self Hosted Chat-GPT
items.kicker: Open Web UI • Docker • Nginx • VPS Tunneling
items.summary: Private ChatGPT instance hosted locally and exposed via VPS tunneling.
items.details: Self-hosted Open Web UI instance connected to OpenAI API. Deployed on a local server using Docker, with Nginx reverse proxy and secure tunneling through a VPS gateway to allow public internet access to the local instance.
bullets: Open Web UI & OpenAI API Integration

items.title: CapySnack Store
items.kicker: Next.js • Google Sheet & Apps Scripts • Vercel
items.summary: Simple static online shop platform using Google Sheets as database and Stock Management.
items.details: A production-ready micro e-commerce website built with Next.js. It uses Google Sheets as a CMS and database via Apps Script. Features include product listing, stock management in sheets, and automated WhatsApp order generation.

items.title: Edge Computing for Smart Agriculture
items.summary: Edge system for processing sensor data on the ground, buffering when the internet is down, and synchronizing to the cloud.
items.details: In this project, I designed an end-to-end architecture: sensor → Raspberry Pi 5 → local buffer → cloud. The main focus: reducing data loss during unstable internet connections and maintaining fast actuator response at the edge.

items.title: Drone VTOL Platform
items.summary: VTOL quadcopter for autonomous flight experiments without GPS.
items.details: Pixhawk + Ardupilot configuration, VTOL flight mode tuning, and ground control station integration. A basis for autonomous flight experiments without GPS.

items.title: Creative & UI/UX Showcase
items.summary: Curated set of graphic design explorations and interface prototypes.
items.details: Single Figma file containing poster explorations, landing pages, and product UI flows. Updates to the Figma file automatically keep this case study current without redeploying the site.

items.title: Centralized Monitoring
items.summary: Centralized monitoring system that aggregates metrics from multiple services into a single Grafana dashboard.
items.details: Built a monitoring stack where Telegraf agents collect metrics from each server and send them to InfluxDB for storage. Grafana then queries InfluxDB to visualize uptime, CPU, memory, disk, and network metrics across the fleet.
bullets: Telegraf agents on each service server

items.title: CI/CD Implementation
items.summary: Automated CI/CD pipeline that builds, tests, and deploys code to Dev, Staging, and Production environments.
items.details: Implemented a delivery workflow where every code change pushed to Bitbucket triggers a pipeline. The pipeline runs build and test stages, then deploys to the target environment (Dev, Staging, or Production) based on the branch or release rules.
bullets: Bitbucket Pipeline automation on every push

items.title: Capy Language Course Website
items.summary: Static company profile website for a language course, focused on clear program info and enrollment CTA.
items.details: Built a lightweight marketing site for a language course, highlighting programs, benefits, and contact details in a fast, mobile-friendly layout.
bullets: Static landing page for course overview
Fast load time and simple navigation
